title: Check the Quickplay Facebook Page for a restriction
why: 54 Reels have 1 view between them and Meta put a spam limit on the Page on 23 October. Only you can see why: the Page's account status is behind the studio login.
steps: Sign in to Facebook with the studio account only, never your own.
Switch to the Quickplay Daily Page (your picture at the top right, then the Page).
Open the Page's Professional dashboard and find Account status (some versions call it Page quality). Also open Account Quality in Meta Business Suite.
Note any restriction, warning or 'limited distribution', with its date and reason. Don't appeal anything yet.
Send a screenshot or the wording to Claude (your pinned Quickplay page or a Claude chat).

title: Find out why TikTok restricted the account on 19 October
why: TikTok blocked the drafts as spam on 19 October and nothing is posted there until we know why. Its reason is only in the app. Don't apply for TikTok's Direct Post audit: its rules turn down tools that post to your own accounts.
steps: In the TikTok app, signed in to the Quickplay account: Profile, the menu at the top right, Settings and privacy, Account, Account status.
Note every violation or restriction with its date and reason.
At developers.tiktok.com, sign in, open Manage apps and the Quickplay app. Note its status (draft, in review or live) and its scopes (for example user.info.basic, video.upload, video.publish).
Send both to Claude.

title: Recommended, free: a Cloudflare Workers AI key (about 25 more scripts a day; no card)
why: 26 October: the four channels now share the free writing models. By the afternoon run the strongest free models were out of their daily quota, the writer fell back to the weakest Lite model, and 3 of 8 scripts failed their checks. Free every day with no card (10,000 neurons a day). More free writers means fewer Shorts fall back to Claude, which spends your allowance. The code is ready and both secret names are already allowed.
steps: Sign up at https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up with the studio Google account (Continue with Google). No card is needed.
Copy the Account ID: Account home, the three dots next to the account name, Copy account ID (it is also the long code in the dashboard address).
Open https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens, Create Token, use the Workers AI template, Continue to summary, Create Token, and copy the token.
At https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/settings/secrets/actions add two secrets: CF_ACCOUNT_ID (the Account ID) and CF_API_TOKEN (the token).

title: Recommended, free: a Mistral key (the biggest free writing allowance; phone check, no card)
why: 26 October: the four channels now share the free writing models. By the afternoon run the strongest free models were out of their daily quota, the writer fell back to the weakest Lite model, and 3 of 8 scripts failed their checks. Mistral's free Experiment plan has the largest allowance of the free keys left. Mistral's free Experiment plan needs a verified phone number but no card (the earlier note that it was business only was wrong). The code already uses it once the secret exists, and the name is already allowed.
steps: Sign in at https://console.mistral.ai with the studio Google account.
Choose the free Experiment plan and verify a phone number.
Open API Keys, Create new key, and copy it.
Add it as the secret MISTRAL_API_KEY at https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/settings/secrets/actions/new.

title: Renew the Instagram seed key (IG_TOKEN) before it runs out
why: IG_TOKEN is a 60-day Instagram key, expected to run out around mid-December. Posting doesn't stop when it does: the live key the automation uses (tokens/instagram.enc) renews itself. But the identity check then opens a 'sign-in has expired' alert, and the seed is needed if that live key is ever lost.
steps: When the alert '🔑 A sign-in has expired: reconnect it' names IG_TOKEN (or by the due date), make a new long-lived key the way the first was made: Meta for Developers, the Quickplay app, Instagram API with Instagram Login, Generate token for quickplaydaily.
Paste it into the IG_TOKEN secret at https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/settings/secrets/actions/IG_TOKEN.
Or ask Claude first whether the seed is still needed.

title: Optional: let the hub's page rebuild only when the page itself changes (one setting)
why: GitHub rebuilds the hub's site after every commit the automation makes, about 160 a day, which is over its soft limit of 10 builds an hour and fills the Actions list (35 of the last 100 runs on 24 October). The hub reads its numbers live, so it only needs a rebuild when docs/ changes. The workflow for that (.github/workflows/pages.yml) is ready and does nothing until this setting is switched.
steps: Open the repository's Pages settings, signed in as the studio GitHub account (quickplay-studio).
Under Build and deployment, change Source from 'Deploy from a branch' to 'GitHub Actions'. Nothing else to set.
Then Actions, pages, Run workflow once, so the hub is published straight away. From then on it redeploys by itself whenever docs/ changes.
To undo: set Source back to 'Deploy from a branch', branch main, folder /docs.
note: GitHub Pages builds from GitHub Actions

title: Optional, free: a SambaNova key (a small extra writing allowance; no card)
why: SambaNova Cloud's free tier needs no card while no payment method is linked: DeepSeek-V3.1, gpt-oss-120b and Llama 3.3 70B get 20 requests a day each. More free writers means fewer Shorts fall back to Claude, which spends your allowance. The code is ready and the secret name is already allowed.
steps: Sign in at https://cloud.sambanova.ai with the studio Google account. Don't add a payment method: the free tier needs none.
Open https://cloud.sambanova.ai/apis, create an API key and copy it.
Add it as the secret SAMBANOVA_API_KEY at https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/settings/secrets/actions/new.

title: Optional: Facebook keys for the clips Pages (FB_CLIPS_PAGE_TOKEN, FB_CLIPS_PAGE_ID)
why: Tonight's batch posted 12 clips to Instagram but none to Facebook: the clips channels have no Facebook Page key in the repository secrets, so Facebook is skipped. Facebook is on a 1-a-day probe for the main channel and gets almost no plays, so this is optional until that probe shows reach.
steps: Only if the Quickplay Clips Facebook Page exists under the studio account: in Meta's Graph API Explorer (signed in as the studio account), get a Page access token for that Page with pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement.
Save it as the repository secret FB_CLIPS_PAGE_TOKEN and the Page id as FB_CLIPS_PAGE_ID (both are already on the identity allowlist).
Nothing else: the next 19:00 UK batch posts the day's clips to the Page too (social_per_day 6).

title: Take the pipeline's Claude calls off your chat allowance: claim the Max API credits and add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
why: The writer's 4 Claude edits a day (and the audit's checks) use CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, which draws on the same Max allowance as your chats. A Max plan includes monthly API credits that cover the Claude API and expire monthly; with an API key the pipeline uses those first (factpack.claude_api) and your chat allowance is left alone.
steps: In claude.ai open Settings, Billing, and claim the monthly API credits (they attach to a Console organisation).
At platform.claude.com, in that organisation, open API Keys and create a key named quickplay.
Save it as the repository secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (already on the identity allowlist). Nothing else changes: the same caps apply (4 edits a day, 3 calls a run).

title: Create the Quickplay Music channel in YouTube Studio and connect it
why: The music category is the strongest we have (median 135 views a Short against 28 for Gaming), so Charlie approved a music-only channel run by the same pipeline. It cannot exist until you create it: the pipeline never creates accounts. Until it is signed in nothing about it runs.
steps: Sign in to YouTube Studio with the studio Google account only, never your own.
Open Settings (bottom left), then Channel, then Add or manage your channels, then Create a channel.
Name it exactly: Quickplay Music.
In YouTube Studio open Customisation, then Basic info, and set the handle to @quickplaymusic (the name the Shorts show on screen); if it is taken, use the nearest and tell Claude which you got.
Open the hub's Accounts tab (or https://quickplay-studio.github.io/quickplay-autopilot/youtube-callback.html) and press Sign in to YouTube, signed in as the studio account.
When Google asks which channel, pick Quickplay Music. On the permissions page tick Select all, then Continue.
Press Copy code on the page that opens.
Within 5 minutes open the social workflow, press Run workflow, paste the code into "YouTube address or code", type music as the channel, and press the green Run workflow.
Nothing posts to Quickplay Music until that works; after it does, the pipeline starts it by itself within the hour.
